svg.title: Figure 3. Claims against shared resources
svg.desc: 7 rows of claims against 17 shared resources; 15 claim-and-resource cells where a shared resource is not analysed under the claim.
svg.text: Figure 3 · Where a dependent failure can start, claim by claim
Each cell: the AND gates under that claim whose inputs share the resource, and whether WP-A-03 lists one of its DFIs under the claim
cluster shows engagement on its own
gates across elements no claim covers
Harness-box supply and switch release default (DFI-27, DFI-28)
Harness connector and CAN wiring (EMC) (DFI-05, DFI-07)
SoC compute, OS and IPC (DFI-14, DFI-25, DFI-29, DFI-31, DFI-32)
Vehicle signals read by host and envelope (torque, cruise, brake, gas, speed) (DFI-10, DFI-11, DFI-15)
Command path to the EPS and PCM (bus 0) (DFI-12)
SoC to MCU link and commands (IF-04, mode, reset, flash) (DFI-13, DFI-24, DFI-34, DFI-35)
Limits and constants of controller and envelope (DFI-08)
Model output and lead input (DFI-26, DFI-30)
Source, authors, toolchain and test oracle (DFI-16, DFI-17, DFI-18, DFI-19, DFI-36)
Generated by dfa_figures.py from the join of dfa_gates.py; a cell lists the worst state among its gates. dfa-gates.md has the gates of every cell.

g.text: Terms: CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · DFI-nn dependent failure initiator (WP-A-03 §4): one cause that could defeat two elements at once · EMC electromagnetic
compatibility: interference between electrical parts and wiring · EPS electric power steering · HMI human-machine interface: display, sounds, cluster · HSE high-speed external
oscillator: the crystal that clocks the panda MCU · IC-nn independence claim (WP-A-03 §2): two elements the safety concept relies on not failing together · IF-nn interface of the item
(WP-C-01 §3.4) · IPC inter-process communication · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · OS-nn operational situation (HARA §3) · PCB printed circuit board · PCM
powertrain control module (engine and drive) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · R-nn shared resource in the DFA map
(08-analyses/dfa/shared-resources.yaml): something two elements both depend on · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · WP-nn work product, e.g.
WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
